messages.onb_hello_question: Hi! I'm Hariku, your slightly nosy new friend. First, which language are we speaking?
messages.onb_hello_intro: I'm going to ask you a few things. Relax, it's not a job interview. You can change every answer later in Preferences. Press Enter to go on, or Escape if you're feeling shy.
messages.onb_name_question: What's your name? The real one, not your gamer tag.
messages.onb_nickname_label: And what should I call you? "Boss" works too. (optional)
messages.onb_name_intro: Your name stays on this computer. I use it to greet you, and you can change it any time in Preferences, Profile. How I talk follows what I call you: try Princess, bro or babyy, and hear the difference.
messages.onb_name_reply@sweet: Hi, {name}! I'm so happy we met, hehe.
messages.onb_name_reply@royal: Greetings, {name}! From this day on, I am your loyal servant.
messages.onb_name_reply@polite: It's a pleasure to meet you, {name}.
messages.onb_where_question: {reply} So, {name}, where do you live? That way I won't say good morning at midnight. Type your city, then press Enter:
messages.onb_where_question@sweet: {reply} Where do you live, {name}? Tell me, so I can say good morning at just the right time. Type your city, then press Enter:
messages.onb_where_question@bro: {reply} So where are you based, {name}? Gotta get the time and the weather right. Type your city, then press Enter:
messages.onb_where_question@royal: {reply} Where is your palace, {name}? Your servant must know, so the hour is never announced wrongly. Type your city, then press Enter:
messages.onb_where_question@polite: {reply} Now, where do you live, {name}? I'd rather not get your time wrong. Type your city, then press Enter:
messages.onb_where_intro: I use your city for the time, the weather and what happens around you. To find it, I send only the name you type to Open-Meteo; for the weather, a point rounded to about 1 kilometre. Want to keep it a secret? Just press Next.
messages.onb_where_intro_keep: Word is your main place is {place}. Still there? Press Next, or find another city if you've moved.
messages.onb_where_none: Hmm, I can't find {query}. Is the city hiding, or is the spelling creative? Try another spelling.
messages.onb_where_none@sweet: Aww, I can't find {query}. Shall we try another spelling?
messages.onb_where_none@bro: Hmm, no {query} anywhere. Typo? Try another spelling.
messages.onb_where_none@royal: Forgive me, {query} is not on the royal map. Try another spelling.
messages.onb_where_none@polite: I couldn't find {query}. Perhaps my map spells it differently; try another spelling.
messages.onb_where_failed: I can't search right now; the internet seems to be taking a nap. Skip this for now; you can add your city later in Preferences, Places.
messages.onb_birthday_question: {reply} Now the most important question: when's your birthday, {name}? Day:
messages.onb_birthday_question@sweet: {reply} Now, this one's super important: when's your birthday, {name}? Day:
messages.onb_birthday_question@bro: {reply} So when's your birthday, {name}? Gotta celebrate. Day:
messages.onb_birthday_question@royal: {reply} When is your royal birthday, {name}? The whole kingdom must know. Day:
messages.onb_birthday_question@polite: {reply} Next question, for celebration purposes: when's your birthday, {name}? Day:
messages.onb_birthday_intro: You can skip this. If you tell me, I'll make the biggest fuss on the day. Leave the year empty if you like; your age is your business, I get it.
messages.onb_birthday_intro@sweet: You can skip this. But if you tell me, I'll be the happiest one wishing you a happy birthday. The year can stay our little secret.
messages.onb_birthday_intro@bro: You can skip it. But fill it in and I'll be hyped on the day. Leave the year empty if you want, no pressure.
messages.onb_birthday_intro@royal: You may skip this. If you tell me, I shall announce a grand celebration on the day. The year may stay secret; a royal's age is no business of the people.
messages.onb_birthday_intro@polite: You can skip this. If you tell me, I'll wish you a happy birthday on the day. Leave the year empty if your age is a secret.
messages.onb_birthday_reply: {date}, noted! Expect a fuss on the day.
messages.onb_birthday_reply@sweet: {date}! Saved somewhere safe; I won't forget.
messages.onb_birthday_reply@royal: {date}! It is written in the royal records.
messages.onb_aruna_question: {reply} Now meet Aruna, {name}, the assistant you can call any time, even at 3 AM. Try it: type what time is it, then press Enter:
messages.onb_aruna_question@sweet: {reply} Now meet Aruna, {name}. Aruna's here for you any time. Try it: type what time is it, then press Enter:
messages.onb_aruna_question@bro: {reply} Meet Aruna, {name}: your go-to sidekick, on call any time. Try it: type what time is it, then press Enter:
messages.onb_aruna_question@royal: {reply} May I present Aruna, {name}, your court adviser, at your service any time. Try it: type what time is it, then press Enter:
messages.onb_aruna_question@polite: {reply} Now let me introduce Aruna, the assistant you can call from anywhere, {name}. Try it: type what time is it, then press Enter:
messages.onb_aruna_intro: Press {shortcut} anywhere, even while Hariku is hidden, and Aruna opens. Type a command and press Enter: what time is it, the weather, or remind me tomorrow at 7 to take my medicine. With the Voice Control extension you can simply talk to Aruna. Here Aruna only answers the time and the date; once we're done with introductions, it can do much more, don't worry.
messages.onb_aruna_empty: The box is empty. I can't read minds yet. Type something first, for example what time is it.
messages.onb_aruna_empty@sweet: Hehe, the box is empty. Type something first, like what time is it.
messages.onb_aruna_empty@bro: It's empty. Type something first, like what time is it.
messages.onb_aruna_empty@royal: Forgive me, your command is empty. Type something first, such as what time is it.
messages.onb_aruna_empty@polite: The box is still empty. Type something first, for example what time is it.
messages.onb_aruna_reminder: Ooh, that's a reminder. Hold that thought: tell Aruna again once we're done with introductions, and I'll save it.
messages.onb_aruna_other: Patience! In here I can only tell the time and the date; the rest comes after introductions. Try what time is it, or what's the date.
messages.onb_aruna_other@sweet: Sorry, in here I can only tell the time and the date. After our introductions I can help with lots more. Try what time is it, or what's the date.
messages.onb_aruna_other@bro: In here I only do the time and the date. The rest comes later, relax. Try what time is it, or what's the date.
messages.onb_aruna_other@royal: Forgive me, in here I can only tell the time and the date. Your other commands must wait until our introductions are done. Try what time is it, or what's the date.
messages.onb_aruna_other@polite: In here I can only tell the time and the date; everything else waits until our introductions are done. Try what time is it, or what's the date.
messages.onb_ext_question: {reply} What else should I learn, {name}? Pick some, I'm a fast learner. Suggested extensions (Space ticks one):
messages.onb_ext_question@sweet: {reply} What else should I learn, so I can help you more, {name}? Suggested extensions (Space ticks one):
messages.onb_ext_question@bro: {reply} What skills should I level up, {name}? Go on, pick. Suggested extensions (Space ticks one):
messages.onb_ext_question@royal: {reply} What new skills shall your servant learn, {name}? Suggested extensions (Space ticks one):
messages.onb_ext_question@polite: {reply} I can also learn new skills, {name}. Which ones shall I install? Suggested extensions (Space ticks one):
messages.onb_ext_intro: Extensions are extra skills for me. I install the ones you tick after you press Finish; nothing is downloaded before that. You can remove them later in the Extension Manager ({shortcut}).
messages.onb_ext_loading: One moment, I'm window-shopping in the Extension Store.
messages.onb_ext_loading@sweet: Just a moment, I'm looking around the Extension Store.
messages.onb_ext_loading@bro: Hang on, checking the Extension Store.
messages.onb_ext_loading@royal: One moment, I am visiting the Extension Store on your behalf.
messages.onb_ext_loading@polite: One moment, I'm browsing the Extension Store.
messages.onb_ext_ready: The Extension Store is here: {count} suggestions.
messages.onb_ext_offline: I can't reach the Extension Store right now. That's fine: visit it later from the Extension Manager ({shortcut}).
messages.onb_ext_all_installed: Oh, you already have everything I'd suggest. Looks like you knew me before I knew you. There are more in the Extension Manager ({shortcut}).
messages.onb_ext_desc_weather: The weather now and for the next 7 days where you live. Ask Aruna: weather.
messages.onb_ext_desc_briefing: A short spoken briefing every morning: a greeting, the date, today's reminders and news from your other extensions. Press B.
messages.onb_ext_desc_timer_alarm: Alarms and timers, typed or spoken to Aruna: alarm tomorrow at 6 AM, timer 10 minutes.
messages.onb_ext_desc_voice_control: Talk to Aruna with your microphone, in English or Indonesian. Your voice is recognised on this computer only; you download the speech model in Preferences, Voice Control.
messages.onb_ext_desc_world_trip: Fly anywhere from Aruna: take me to Tokyo. The local time, the weather, a greeting in the local language and live local radio.
messages.onb_ext_desc_earthquake: The latest earthquake from BMKG, recent earthquakes in Indonesia, and tsunami warnings.
messages.onb_ext_desc_world_clock: The time now in cities around the world.
messages.onb_ext_desc_air_quality: The air quality and the UV index where you live.
messages.onb_ext_desc_lumina: Birthday reminders for your friends and family.
messages.onb_startup_question: {reply} Last one, I promise: can I wake up whenever your computer does, {name}? I'm not noisy. Well, only a little.
messages.onb_startup_question@sweet: {reply} Last one, {name}: can I wake up whenever your computer does? Then I get to say hi to you first.
messages.onb_startup_question@bro: {reply} Last thing, {name}: I boot up with your computer, deal? That way I'm ready to roll.
messages.onb_startup_question@royal: {reply} One last request, {name}: may I rise whenever your computer does?
messages.onb_startup_question@polite: {reply} Last question, {name}: may I wake up whenever your computer does?
messages.onb_startup_intro: With both ticked, I greet you as soon as your computer is ready and online, like this: {example}
messages.onb_done_birthday: On {date} I'll wish you a happy birthday.
messages.onb_done_greet_boot: Every time your computer starts, I'll greet you.
messages.onb_done_greet: Every time Hariku starts, I'll greet you.
messages.onb_done_autostart: I'll start together with your computer.
messages.onb_done_extensions: When you press Finish, I'll install {names}.
messages.onb_done_welcome: From now on I'm right here, ready to be bothered any time. Welcome to Hariku!
messages.onb_done_welcome@sweet: From now on I'm always here for you. Welcome to Hariku!
messages.onb_done_welcome@bro: From now on I'm on standby. Welcome to Hariku!
messages.onb_done_welcome@royal: From now on, I am at your service at any hour. Welcome to Hariku!
messages.onb_done_welcome@polite: From now on, I'm here whenever you need me. Welcome to Hariku.
messages.onb_install_start: Installing {count} extensions. This takes a moment.
messages.onb_install_partly: Installed: {names}. Not installed: {failed}; try again later in the Extension Manager ({shortcut}).
messages.onb_install_failed: I couldn't install {failed}; try again later in the Extension Manager ({shortcut}).
messages.onb_install_close@royal: Press Enter, and let the day begin!
messages.onb_cancel_message: Leaving already? What you entered won't be saved. Don't worry, I won't sulk; we can get acquainted any time from Help, Welcome Dialog.
messages.onb_cancel_message@sweet: Stopping for now? What you entered won't be saved. That's okay; whenever you like, we can get acquainted again from Help, Welcome Dialog.
messages.onb_cancel_message@bro: Heading out? What you entered won't be saved. No worries, we can pick this up any time from Help, Welcome Dialog.
messages.onb_cancel_message@royal: Leaving so soon? What you entered won't be saved. I shall wait faithfully; we can get acquainted again from Help, Welcome Dialog.
messages.onb_cancel_message@polite: Stop now? What you entered here won't be saved. We can get acquainted any time from Help, Welcome Dialog.
messages.profile_help: Use %myname%, %mytitle%, %mynickname%, %mybirthday% or %myage% in routines, reminders and your startup greeting. Don't store passwords here; the profile is saved unencrypted on this computer.

messages.profile_nothing_selected: Select a placeholder in the list first.
messages.profile_err_key_empty: Type a name for the placeholder.

messages.profile_err_key_chars: A placeholder name can only use letters a to z, digits and underscores, without spaces.

messages.profile_err_key_windows: %{token}% is a Windows variable name. Choose another name.
messages.profile_err_key_duplicate: You already have %{token}%. Choose another name.

messages.profile_chk_boot_only: Only when Hariku starts with Windows

messages.profile_err_title_too_long: The title is too long. It can be at most {max} characters.

messages.token_desc_greeting: good morning, good afternoon and so on, for the time of day
messages.token_desc_zulu: the time in UTC, as pilots say it (Zulu)
messages.token_desc_reminders: how many reminders you still have today
messages.profile_err_birthday_incomplete: Choose both the day and the month of your birthday, or neither.
messages.profile_err_birthday_invalid: That date does not exist. Check the day and the month of your birthday.
messages.profile_err_birthday_year: The year of your birthday must be a number from {min} to {max}, or left empty.
messages.profile_err_quiet_time: Choose the times as hours and minutes, for example 22:00.
messages.profile_err_quiet_same: Quiet hours can't start and end at the same time.
messages.quiet_help: During quiet hours, extension alerts stay silent and are not repeated later: aircraft overhead and aircraft emergencies, high waves, unhealthy air, and earthquakes. Tsunami warnings, your own reminders, launch reminders you set, and routines still sound.
messages.prefs_aruna_keep_open_note: For commands that only tell you something, such as the time, the weather or the latest earthquake, and after a reminder is saved: the answer shows in Last result and Aruna waits for your next command. Press Escape to close it. Commands that open a window, or act on the window you were in, still close Aruna first.
messages.prefs_aruna_sounds_note: A sound when you send a typed message, and another when Aruna answers. A sound theme can replace them (aruna_send.wav and aruna_reply.wav).
messages.voice_windows_privacy: Windows voices speak on this computer. The text they read never leaves it.
messages.voice_help: Hariku Voice reads the announcements you choose below with a voice of your choice instead of your screen reader. Everything else stays with your screen reader, and a braille display still shows the text.
messages.voice_chk_greeting: Read the startup greeting with Hariku Voice
messages.voice_chk_briefing: Read the Briefing and the evening summary with Hariku Voice
messages.voice_chk_reminder: Read reminders with Hariku Voice when they are due
messages.voice_chk_command: Read Aruna's answers with Hariku Voice
messages.nav_command_bar: Open Aruna: type or say a command
messages.guides_none: No installed extension has a guide yet.
messages.cmd_status_typing: Type a command and press Enter. To speak commands, get Voice Control from the Extension Store.
messages.cmd_status_ready: Type a command and press Enter, or press {shortcut} to speak.
messages.cmd_status_listening: Listening. Press {shortcut} or Enter to stop.
messages.cmd_status_answered: Aruna answered. Type another command, or press Escape to close.
messages.cmd_status_question: Aruna asks: Enter or "yes" for yes, Escape or "no" for no.
messages.cmd_empty: Type or say a command, for example "what time is it" or "remind me to take medicine tomorrow at 8".
messages.cmd_offer_reminder: That's not in my dictionary yet. Want it as a quick reminder instead?
messages.cmd_offer_reminder@sweet: I don't understand that one yet. Shall I make it a quick reminder?
messages.cmd_offer_reminder@bro: Didn't catch that one. Make it a quick reminder?
messages.cmd_offer_reminder@royal: Forgive me, I do not yet understand that command. Shall I make it a quick reminder?
messages.cmd_offer_reminder@polite: That command isn't in my vocabulary yet. Shall I make it a quick reminder?
messages.cmd_not_understood: Hmm, that's not in my dictionary yet. Try other words?
messages.cmd_not_understood@sweet: Sorry, I don't understand that one yet. Could you say it another way?
messages.cmd_not_understood@bro: Didn't catch that one. Try other words?
messages.cmd_not_understood@royal: Forgive me, I do not yet understand that command. Would you phrase it another way?
messages.cmd_not_understood@polite: Sorry, that isn't in my vocabulary yet. Could you put it another way?
messages.cmd_cancelled@royal: Very well, the command is withdrawn.
messages.cmd_save_failed: The reminder could not be saved.
messages.cmd_action_failed: Oops, I couldn't pull that off.
messages.cmd_action_failed@sweet: Oh no, sorry, that one didn't work.
messages.cmd_action_failed@bro: Ah, that one failed. Try again later.
messages.cmd_action_failed@royal: A thousand apologies, I could not carry that out.
messages.cmd_action_failed@polite: Sorry, I couldn't carry that out.
messages.cmd_heard_nothing: I didn't hear a thing. Were you whispering? Try again.
messages.cmd_heard_nothing@sweet: Hmm, I didn't hear anything. Could you say it again?
messages.cmd_heard_nothing@bro: Didn't hear a thing. Try again?
messages.cmd_heard_nothing@royal: Forgive me, I heard nothing. Would you say it again?
messages.cmd_heard_nothing@polite: I didn't hear anything. Try again, a little louder?

messages.voice_test_text_noname: Good morning. This is your Hariku voice.

messages.places_main_none: None yet. Add a place; the first one becomes the main place.
messages.places_privacy: Places are kept only on this computer. Services get a place rounded to about 1 kilometre, never the exact point. Searching for an address sends what you type to OpenStreetMap; searching for a city sends it to Open-Meteo.
